svg.title: What kitden-sdlc runs
svg.desc: Three lanes in Kitden's look. Left of the dashed line the model only reads; right of it a script without a model writes. Review is live: Claude and Luna read a pull request, and Lantern posts one comment. The client watcher is measuring: Luna judges the three clients' docs, and Lantern opens an issue in Kitden. The release flow is being built: Claude drafts the release pull request, you merge it, a script tags it, and scripts update PyPI, Homebrew, the MCP Registry, the Claude directory and the release branch.
